scope: Exact inherited interface limits and same-frontier extensions; these are local authoring obligations, not permission to weaken claims or create duplicate canonical methods.

rows.limit: Conditional on local reflector-action A1; no computed formation proof, no general complex arithmetic model.
rows.required_delta: Prove declared sqrt/complex arithmetic and reflector local bound; preserve published conditional theorem and aggregate only after actual premise is supplied.

rows.limit: Both literal Statements restrict to real finite-dimensional inner product spaces; PC-SCF matrices may be complex Hermitian.
rows.owner: PC-SCF; share downstream with VAL-LINEAR if actually needed
rows.required_delta: Prove the needed complex Hermitian operator-norm eigenvalue perturbation/gap bound locally from complex spectral decomposition/minmax, or supply rigorous realification and doubled multiplicity argument. Do not silently widen the imported theorem.

rows.limit: AC complex Banach projection decomposition/spectrum theorem; no quantitative spectral-projector derivative or contraction constant.
rows.required_delta: Prove common separating contour or Sylvester derivative and uniform resolvent/gap constants; carry AC and actual invariant neighborhood. New matrix calculation may be proved directly without changing Banach supplier.

rows.limit: Closed sector away from the negative-real cut and asymptotic O_delta(1/z), without an explicit certified finite remainder constant.
rows.required_delta: Prove method/domain-specific explicit truncation/remainder and range/branch predicates before advertising numerical accuracy or stopping.

rows.limit: Triangular form assumes characteristic polynomial splits over the selected field; real unsplit matrices need real quasi-triangular blocks.
rows.owner: LIN-SCHUR; LIN-QZ consumes the proved extension
rows.required_delta: Prove real Schur 1x1/2x2 block form and actual shifted/deflated computation separately; existing exact existence does not prove computed QR stability or convergence.

rows.limit: Exact radix2/normalization and complex arithmetic counts, excluding twiddle generation, integer indexing, memory/bit work and floating stability.
rows.required_delta: Reuse canonical FFT; prove declared rounded butterfly/twiddle perturbation model and range bound, or clearly supplied twiddle oracle error. New mixed-radix/Bluestein/NUFFT variants need their own correctness/error.

rows.limit: Real covariance input and positive-definite leading blocks; forecast right-hand side and exact arithmetic.
rows.required_delta: Reuse recurrence. Prove general RHS/Hermitian/displacement or finite-precision extensions with admissible pivots; no unqualified arbitrary Toeplitz stability.

rows.limit: Bounded C1 domain, 1<p<infinity, AC; it cannot directly supply simplex/polyhedral face traces or Hcurl tangential traces.
rows.owner: NA-28 reference-cell and Lipschitz interfaces; PE08/PE09 weak Hdiv/Hcurl regular decomposition/trace extensions
rows.required_delta: Author local cell Green/trace/scaling, proper Lipschitz trace/lifting and Hcurl/Hdiv structures under exact geometry; retain every declared same-frontier analytic supplier.

rows.limit: Bounded C2 domain n>=2 with actual coefficients and a preexisting H10 weak solution; Countable Choice; kernel-dependent L2 term remains.
rows.required_delta: Use only under stated regularity; prove weaker-index corner/domain estimates where promised, or preserve conditional rates. Do not infer existence, arbitrary Lipschitz H2, or omit the kernel term.

rows.limit: One-dimensional clamped knots and specified bounded local quasi-interpolant, AC; degree/multiplicity and representative assumptions explicit.
rows.owner: APP-SPLINE for evaluation/numerical delta; NA-28 for multidimensional FEM approximation
rows.required_delta: Reuse canonical Cox-deBoor/basis/1D approximation; prove deBoor evaluation/knot insertion and actual roundoff, and separate BrambleHilbert/cell scaling for FEM.

rows.limit: Fixed1/L gradient rate and local Newton with stopping/decrement conditions; existing definitions are mathematical iterations unless caller/budget wrapper bounds them.
rows.required_delta: Preserve canonical procedures; prove exact-line-search/global Armijo/finite dampedphase and inexact residual certificates locally. New nonconvex or constrained methods are distinct variants, not renamed existing algorithms.

rows.limit: FiniteL2 globally Lipschitz/growth/halfHolder time and filtration independence; weak theorem separately assumes backward mixed regularity/moments. Neither supplies superlinear/tamed, Milstein, MLMC higherorder or Levy-area claims.
rows.required_delta: Reuse matching EM variant unchanged; locally prove each higher-order/tamed/coupling/area/moment/backward-regularity contract and computational draw model.

rows.limit: Global potential domain and measure-preserving/reversibility conclusions; local potential domain, symplectic pullback and error/modified-energy bounds are distinct.
rows.required_delta: Reuse global kick/drift maps; add only domain restriction plus actual symplectic/error/energy proof with controlled intermediate states and regularity.

rows.limit: Fixed finite matrix/exact data, lambda-to-zero pseudoinverse convergence; no noisy compact-inverse source-condition rate or choice rule.
rows.required_delta: Keep canonical regularizer definition; author operator/data/discretization and source-condition/noise/stopping/parameter rule proof, including all nullspace and branch conventions.

rows.limit: Scalar common-reference chain and actual joint square-integrable covariance identity; not arbitrary normed-space or independence-free root-sum-square accuracy.
rows.required_delta: One common-norm/Minkowski extension and genuinely new operator/optimizer/ODE/quadrature instances. Scalar definitions/results stay canonical.

rows.limit: Law/CDF and reverse randomized transform do not license an example as a logical premise or prove finite-bit/stream implementation error.
rows.required_delta: Typed generalized-inverse sublevel identity with full proof/source attribution, ideal-bit uniformity/independence and actual finite-bit error; example context only. Carry Countable Choice from law/CDF route.

rows.limit: Estimator/existence/statistical inequality and a contextual orthogonal-design example do not prove coordinate-descent convergence or a logical soft-threshold subprocedure.
rows.required_delta: Typed one-coordinate soft-threshold minimizer/zero-column lemma and actual block/randomized convergence proof; published example remains context only.

rows.limit: Existing homological proof carries actual category/set-theory closure; finite numerical data do not erase these dependencies.
rows.owner: Existing foundation seven-file grounding maintenance plus PE06/PE12 actual application
rows.required_delta: Ground class/cardinal convention uses in typed definitions without weakening Brouwer or duplicating the theorem. Existence applications still state full finite-dimensional hypotheses and are not finite algorithms by themselves.
